mapper.insert: INSERT INTO a2a_task_store (task_id, context_id, state, status_timestamp, encrypted_payload, updated_at) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{contextId}, #{state}, #{statusTimestamp}, #{encryptedPayload}, #{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE context_id = VALUES(context_id), state = VALUES(state), status_timestamp = VALUES(status_timestamp), encrypted_payload = VALUES(encrypted_payload), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
